summary: BOTH_PARTLY. The fresh Q4 is not controlling wholesale. Six current IDs remain controlling after semantic narrowing: Q4-001 only for the repair-added os.replace mechanism coupling; Q4-002 as a repair regression that reintroduces undocumented archive/publication representation; Q4-003 and Q4-004 as incomplete prior operator-health repair; Q4-006 only for failure to isolate archive-owned registry attribution; and Q4-007 as a valid latent public-policy-authority ambiguity. Q4-005 is rejected as overbroad because the prior adjudication required representative end-to-end publication-boundary proof, not every safety subclass end-to-end. The corrupt/missing archive-input portion of Q4-006 and the blanket private src.* ABI theory in Q4-001 are also rejected. The task remains BLOCKED now. One final circuit-breaker closure repair is authorized only within the exact bounded scope recorded here; this is not another blind Q4 patch cycle.

findings.criterion: Q4-001 disposition: NARROWED_VALID_FINDING / REPAIR_REGRESSION. Blanket private-src ABI objection rejected; repair-added os.replace mechanism coupling remains controlling.
findings.why_it_matters: The broad src.* import/unit-test structure already existed and the fresh Q4 does not establish that every inherited helper call is an independently graded public ABI. Treating all such tests as invalid over-expands prior scope. The repair did add monkeypatch.setattr("src.publication.os.replace", ...), making correctness depend on one atomic-promotion mechanism although the public requirement is atomic externally visible promotion.
findings.minimal_remediation: Remove the os.replace-specific injection and equivalent mechanism-only dependency; preserve atomic failure-safety through observable filesystem/publication behavior. Do not rewrite all inherited src.* semantic unit tests merely because they import internal modules.
findings.regression_risk: Do not weaken atomicity coverage or create a blanket private-module prohibition.

findings.criterion: Q4-002 disposition: REPAIR_REGRESSION / VALID_BLOCKER. Repair introduced undocumented archive/publication representation contracts contrary to the prior guardrail.
findings.why_it_matters: Prior adjudication required independent archive/publication verification without replacing circular booleans with undocumented filename, serialization or manifest-shape oracles. The repair improved the old exact manifest helper but added archive assertions requiring CSV/JSON file types and a byte-identical publication-manifest copy, none promised publicly.
findings.minimal_remediation: Keep independent generation, digest, lineage, control/delta, journal, retention and non-mutation verification but remove extension, placement, byte-identical-copy and incidental serialization assumptions. Do not document the current implementation merely to legalize them.
findings.regression_risk: Preserve independently computed integrity checks while restoring implementation freedom.

findings.criterion: Q4-003 disposition: INCOMPLETE_PRIOR_REPAIR / VALID_BLOCKER. Documented preflight health families remain insufficiently perturbed.
findings.why_it_matters: Prior ADJ-Q4-001 already authorized grouped black-box perturbations across distinct documented preflight/audit health families. The repair demonstrates baseline, catalog and recovery behavior, but the unchanged public contract also names schema health, source framing/profile, input integrity, batch-window and authorization/safety state. Those can remain decorative under the current suite.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add the smallest grouped black-box perturbations proving the remaining distinct preflight health families materially affect public preflight outcome/evidence; one scenario may cover multiple fields when it genuinely exercises a shared invariant.
findings.regression_risk: Use public CLI/state effects, not incidental JSON layout or private call paths.

findings.criterion: Q4-004 disposition: INCOMPLETE_PRIOR_REPAIR / VALID_BLOCKER. Documented audit health families remain partially decorative.
findings.why_it_matters: Prior operator-health closure included audit. Current tests exercise several audit families, but replay/recovery identity, control/reconciliation and publication-registry health remain unchallenged even though they are explicit public audit responsibilities.
findings.minimal_remediation: Use grouped black-box/state perturbations to prove the uncovered audit responsibility families affect the public audit result/evidence. Reuse one perturbation when it legitimately proves multiple related domains.
findings.regression_risk: Do not require exact audit JSON organization or internal helper calls.

findings.criterion: Q4-005 disposition: OVERBROAD/REVIEWER_OVERREACH. Rejected as a task blocker.
findings.why_it_matters: Prior adjudication required representative real reconcile-to-pipeline-to-publication proof: a legacy mismatch plus a safety/detailed-settlement failure with independent no-publication evidence. Current Q4 acknowledges a legacy mismatch and a missing-effect detailed-settlement failure now block publication. Requiring duplicate-effect-kind, negative-value, duplicate/orphan and unbalanced-transfer subclasses each end-to-end expands that representative boundary.
findings.minimal_remediation: None under Q4-005. Preserve representative end-to-end gating proof and direct reconciliation/safety tests; do not add one publication test per safety subclass.
findings.regression_risk: Over-expansion would recreate a test inventory and defeat the circuit breaker without adding a distinct boundary guarantee.

findings.criterion: Q4-006 disposition: NARROWED_VALID_FINDING / INCOMPLETE_PRIOR_REPAIR. Registry attribution controls; corrupt/missing archive-input testing is rejected as newly dripped.
findings.why_it_matters: The repair substantially closes prior archive circularity by independently inspecting artifacts, lineage/digests, journal event, retention and live-set non-mutation. It isolates new journal rows, but its registry check can be satisfied by publication evidence that existed before archive, so the archive workflow's documented registry responsibility is not attributed. Missing/corrupt report/publication input was not part of the prior adjudicated remedy and is newly dripped here.
findings.minimal_remediation: Snapshot or otherwise distinguish registry state before and after archive and prove archive creates/updates the documented archive-owned registry evidence using stable public semantics. Do not add a corrupt/missing-input scenario in this closure repair.
findings.regression_risk: Do not reintroduce exact registry serialization, filenames or private registry APIs.

findings.criterion: Q4-007 disposition: LATENT_REVIEWER_OMISSION / NARROWED_VALID_FINDING / VALID_BLOCKER. Reason/type ambiguity is closed; unchanged movement/item/warehouse authority remains materially underdefined.
findings.why_it_matters: The repair correctly adds the prior-adjudicated reason/type map. The remaining movement-shape/item-policy/warehouse-capability issue is semantically unchanged prior scope even though the containing instruction bullet changed, so TOUCHED_BY_REPAIR is not dispositive. Public catalog state does not expose the private WarehousePolicy allow_* capability flags used by tests; competent repairs can therefore differ on graded acceptance decisions.
findings.minimal_remediation: Define only the minimum functional authority needed for grading: state the required/forbidden source/destination and quantity/distinctness rules that are actually graded; identify which solver-visible item catalog fields govern active/max-unit-cost/precision decisions; define intended active-warehouse applicability; and either name a solver-visible persisted/configured source for receipt/issue/transfer capability restrictions or remove tests grading private WarehousePolicy allow_* fields. Do not expose private class names, labels or a hidden case table.
findings.regression_risk: Do not invent new capability storage solely for tests or promote private policy dataclasses to public ABI.
